**Recommendation (what the bots level with).** The party fixtures put this class on holy (14 members), shadow (2 members). The main line is **holy** — Endgame build (level 60), 14/37/0, with a respec at level 60. Every order below is what the module grants level by level (the earlier builds first, then the level-60 build). ## Gameplay by level

The combat rules that come online in each bracket, in the loop's own order (ascending priority). `level_min` is the rule's own gate; the decision loop skips a rule until then. Rest, food and drink rules are left out here and their items are in the band tables below.

### Holy

#### Levels 10–19

- **7 — Resurrection** (`H13-resurrection`, level 10+) — When: not in combat; a dead party member within 30 yd; the resident is not moving; mana at least 30%; no party member below 35% health.
- **20 — Inner Fire** (`H02-inner-fire`, level 12+) — When: the resident does not have Inner Fire; at least 30 mana; (in combat or the resident is not eating or drinking).
- **43 — Heal** (`H07t-heal-tank-heavy`, level 16+) — When: character level below 60; in combat; target health below 65%; at least 3 engaged enemies within 40 yd; the target is within 40 yd; the resident is not moving; at least 155 mana; the target lives at least 3 s.
- **47 — Dispel Magic** (`H12m-dispel-magic-must`, level 18+) — When: mana at least 20%; (in combat or the resident is not eating or drinking).
- **70 — Heal** (`H07-heal`, level 16+) — When: character level below 60; target health below 60%; the resident is not moving; at least 155 mana; (in combat or the resident is not eating or drinking); the target lives at least 3 s.
- **110 — Cure Disease** (`H11-cure-disease`, level 14+) — When: the target has a dispellable disease effect; mana at least 50%; (in combat or the resident is not eating or drinking).
- **120 — Dispel Magic** (`H12-dispel-magic`, level 18+) — When: the target has a dispellable magic effect; mana at least 50%; (not in combat or mana at least 60%); (in combat or the resident is not eating or drinking).
- **140 — Psychic Scream** (`H14-psychic-scream`, level 14+) — When: at least 1 enemy within 8 yd; own health below 40%; Psychic Scream is off cooldown; at least 100 mana; the lowest party health below 0%; not a polymorphed or otherwise CC'd unit within 10 yd.

#### Levels 20–29

- **2 — Fear Ward** (`H00f-fear-ward-tank-boss`, level 20+) — When: the pull is a boss pull; the target does not have Fear Ward; the target is within 30 yd; Fear Ward is off cooldown; the resident is not moving; at least 100 mana.
- **3 — Fear Ward** (`H00f2-fear-ward-tank-pull`, level 20+) — When: the tank is about to pull; the pull is not a boss pull; mana at least 60%; the target does not have Fear Ward; the target is within 30 yd; Fear Ward is off cooldown; the resident is not moving; at least 100 mana.
- **40 — Flash Heal** (`H04-flash-heal`, level 20+) — When: (target health below 35% or the target dies in less than 3 s); the resident is not moving; at least 125 mana; mana at least 20%.
- **42 — Fear Ward** (`H00g-fear-ward-tank-feared`, level 20+) — When: in combat; a party member is feared; the target does not have Fear Ward; the target is within 30 yd; Fear Ward is off cooldown; at least 100 mana.
- **124 — Shackle Undead** (`H13m-shackle-undead-moon`, level 20+) — When: (in combat or the tank is about to pull); the target is Undead; the target is within 30 yd; the resident is not moving; at least 90 mana; (not (the target has Shackle Undead or the target has Shackle Undead or the target has Shackle Undead) and at least 2 engaged enemies within 40 yd or at least 1 engaged enemy within 40 yd and not (the target's victim is the damage or the target's victim is the tank or the target's victim is the healer) or the target has Shackle Undead or the target has Shackle Undead or the target has Shackle Undead and not (the target's Shackle Undead time left is at least 3 s or the target's Shackle Undead time left is at least 3 s or the target's Shackle Undead time left is at least 3 s) and at least 1 engaged enemy within 40 yd).
- **125 — Shackle Undead** (`H13a-shackle-undead-second`, level 20+) — When: in combat; the target is attacking the resident; the target is Undead; the target does not have Shackle Undead; the target is within 30 yd; the resident is not moving; at least 90 mana.
- **162 — Holy Fire** (`H16s-holy-fire-solo`, level 20+) — When: the lowest party health below 0%; the target is hostile; the target is within 30 yd; the resident is not moving; the target does not have Holy Fire; target health at least 90%; at least 85 mana; mana at least 25%.
- **166 — Smite** (`H18b-smite-run-in-solo`, level 20+) — When: the lowest party health below 0%; the target is hostile; the target is within 30 yd; the resident is not moving; not in melee range; at least 20 mana; mana at least 25%.

#### Levels 30–39

- **4 — Lightwell** (`H02l-lightwell-before-the-pull`, level 30+) — When: the party has a living member; the tank is about to pull; Lightwell is off cooldown; the resident is not moving; mana at least 60%.

- **48 — Abolish Disease** (`H10m-abolish-disease-must`, level 32+) — When: mana at least 20%; (in combat or the resident is not eating or drinking).
- **50 — Prayer of Healing** (`H05-prayer-of-healing`, level 30+) — When: at least 3 party members below 70% health; the resident is not moving; at least 410 mana; (in combat or the resident is not eating or drinking).

- **165 — Smite** (`H18c-smite-phase-solo`, level 30+) — When: the lowest party health below 0%; the target is hostile; the target is within 30 yd; the resident is not moving; at least 20 mana; mana at least 25%; target health at least 20%.

#### Levels 40–49

- **-110 — Apply Brilliant Mana Oil** (`H00u-mana-oil`, level 45+) — When: (the main hand is a one-handed axe or the main hand is a two-handed axe or the main hand is a one-handed mace or the main hand is a two-handed mace or the main hand is a polearm or the main hand is a one-handed sword or the main hand is a two-handed sword or the main hand is a staff or the main hand is a fist weapon or the main hand is a dagger or the main hand is a weapon); not in combat; the resident is not moving; carries Brilliant Mana Oil; (the main hand does not have Brilliant Mana Oil or main-hand imbue time left is less than 300 s); the resident is not eating or drinking.

## Situational rules

Sentences copied from the rules' own notes, where the poison/creature-type, seal, stance, form and consumable advice lives.

### Holy

- **H07t-heal-tank-heavy:** HO-TKB-PLAY-151 (orchestrator, the owner's SFK priority: round 134's leveller wipes began with the healer at a median 4 per cent mana but the wiping fights opened at a median 100, so they drained a full healer; in those fights the healer's tank heals were Lesser Heal 49, Renew 35, Heal 21, docs/research/tkb/play/sfk-class-forensics.py): "Tank low (about half health): Max-rank Lesser Heal (R3), or Heal R1 from 16 when damage is heavy"; "the big heal kept ready for bosses and 3+ mob pulls" (priest/leveling.md L125-L126).
- **H00f-fear-ward-tank-boss:** HO-TKB-PLAY-129 (p4-pioneer decision 189 (d), rotation gaps for track 1 at level 22): "Fear Ward on the tank before fearing bosses" (priest/leveling.md L153; baseline for every race on Turtle, L252), on the tank while the tank readies a boss pull (party.pull_is_boss). Every boss pull, because no field says which bosses fear: 100 mana and a 30 s cooldown for a 10 minute ward.
- **H00f2-fear-ward-tank-pull:** HO-TKB-PLAY-129 (p4-pioneer decision 189 (d), rotation gaps for track 1 at level 22): "Fear Ward on the tank before fearing bosses" (priest/leveling.md L153; baseline for every race on Turtle, L252), on the tank while the tank readies a boss pull (party.pull_is_boss). Every boss pull, because no field says which bosses fear: 100 mana and a 30 s cooldown for a 10 minute ward.
- **H00g-fear-ward-tank-feared:** HO-TKB-PLAY-155 (orchestrator, p4-dungeon's mechanics audit: the fear bosses Dragonmaw Halgan, Stormwrought Balor and Halthas): Fear Ward on the tank in the fight once anyone is feared (party.any_feared), so the boss's next fear misses the tank ("Fear Ward on the tank before fearing bosses", priest/leveling.md L153). The ward does not break a fear already on the tank; it lasts 10 minutes or one fear, 30 s cooldown, 100 mana; `not aura_target(6346)` keeps a second priest from re-warding.
- **H00h-prepull-renew:** HO-TKB-PLAY-025 (vocabulary v8, HO-P1-LOOP-016): Renew on the tank before a boss pull (`target: tank`). Priority 1: a boss pull outranks a drink in progress.
- **H13-resurrection:** `mana_pct >= 30`, not 75, is new, and the unit is the whole reason it is not 75: `manaCostPercentage` is a share of BASE mana (Spell::CalculatePowerCost) while `mana_pct` binds to the CURRENT pool (`state-vocabulary.yaml`), and this file's own H12-dispel-magic already measured the gap between the two - 18 per cent of base cost exactly 85 mana off a 1190-point bar, so base is about 472, which is the "480" this file's own mana-curve section states and derives its 2.48 pool-to-base ratio from. `mana_pct >= 30` is that conversion, not a re-use of the cleanses' unrelated flat 30 per cent reserve (H10-H12, whose own costs are 15-18 per cent of base and would convert to about 6-7 per cent of pool - their 30 is a floor, not a conversion).
- **H01-fortitude:** HO-TKB-PLAY-025 (vocabulary v8, HO-P1-LOOP-016): `target: party_missing`: the nearest member in range and sight (the resident first, at 0 yd) lacking this buff's aura chain, instead of the lowest-health member; the one-member limit described below is gone. So `aura_target` here asks about whichever ally is currently lowest on health, never about whoever is missing the buff, and a member that loses it waits for its own health to make it the selection.
- **H02-inner-fire:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). With Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0 any cast stands a seated resident up, and in rounds 11-17 buffs, pet upkeep, dispels and non-emergency heals ended drinks and meals out of combat in every mana spec streamed (docs/research/tkb/play/r17-rest-breaks.txt).
- **H02b-divine-spirit:** HO-TKB-PLAY-025 (vocabulary v8, HO-P1-LOOP-016): `target: party_missing`: the nearest member in range and sight (the resident first, at 0 yd) lacking this buff's aura chain, instead of the lowest-health member; the one-member limit described below is gone. ONE MEMBER PER TICK, NOT THE PARTY (HO-TKB-PLAY2-001, OQ-2811): Tick.cpp picks exactly one healTarget - the lowest-health living member, or the tank while it holds hostiles under Bots.HealTankFirstPct, or the resident under Bots.HealSelfFloorPct - and Party.cpp aims buffs at that same one unit, so `aura_target` here asks about whichever ally is currently lowest on health and never about whoever is missing the buff.
- **H03s-shield-self-pressed:** H03-shield (30) shields the HEAL target under 30 per cent, so a healer that is the one being hit never got a shield (round 108, 5 deaths of a priest in a party: no shield aura in the 15 s before any).
- **H03-shield:** Weakened Soul (6788) blocks a second shield for 15 s and the spell carries a 4 s categoryRecoveryTime of its own, so both gates are here: the aura test for the debuff the core applies and cooldown_ready for the category.
- **H03b-inner-focus-prayer:** Inner Focus is 180 s, 0 mana, aura 108 -101 per cent mana cost on the next spell (tkbplay-220.result.txt).
- **H02d-ascendance:** The guide: for 30 s heals cost about a third less and cast about a fifth faster, targets gain +15 per cent healing taken, it also breaks CC; "press it just before a boss enrages" and "Save Ascendance for enrage and burst windows" (holy.md L3, L46, L149). THE PROXY IS OURS: the rotation vocabulary has no enrage timer and cannot read a boss's phase from a healer's heal-target view (target.boss is the hostile target), so 'burst' is read from the party's health, which spends the cooldown during damage and not before it; the enrage timing is proposed as an open question.
- **H03a-inner-focus:** The first use, spending it on a specific max-rank spell, needs a way to bind a buff to the next cast that the rule format has not got.
- **H09w-renew-weave-self:** So the weave is a rank-1 Renew (30 mana) on the priest herself, ONLY when nobody in the party is under 70 per cent (so it costs no needed heal and never competes with H09/H09b/H04b), and only right after a Flash Heal (cast within 3.5 s) that is more recent than the last Renew (so Renew is never cast twice in a row, which would not refund).
- **H09-renew:** Stops at "not present" because v2 cannot see how long an aura has left (OQ-1402). `not aura_target(139)` is also the only per-target "I healed this one a moment ago" guard the vocabulary has, and it is why Renew needs no other repeat guard while the direct heals below it do (OQ-2517).
- **H09b-renew-topup:** `not aura_target(139)` is the same per-target repeat guard H09 carries and the only one the vocabulary offers (OQ-2517), so this rule cannot re-lay a Renew that is already ticking on the same chosen target. The mana guard is two-part and both halves are load-bearing: `mana_pct >= 30`, at least as strict as the reserve this file's three cleanses already carry (H10/H11/H12, OQ-2803, OQ-2519), because this is the lowest-urgency heal in the file (everyone is at or above 70) and must not be the cast that empties the bar; and `mana >= 30`, Renew's own rank-1 cost and the same absolute floor H09-renew uses (spell_template 139, manaCost 30 at rank 1, 105 at rank 3 - H09's own cite).

HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435).
- **H10m-abolish-disease-must:** HO-TKB-PLAY-186 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator: owner ruling, meaningful dispels not random; decision 214's principle): the MUST-REMOVE half. amp-5's DB study (harmful player debuffs per dungeon, 2026-10-16: 41 of about 120 removable debuffs are must-remove: control, charm, silence, fear, heal and cast slows, the heavy damage-over-time curses and diseases) names the ids, and this rule removes them by id, high in the ladder so it reacts fast, reading the heal target today (the afflicted member only when it is the heal target; p4-group's view will aim it). The generic cleanse further down the file is now 'when free': below every heal rule and behind a 50 per cent mana floor, so a trivial debuff never costs a heal or the mana for one.
- **H10-abolish-disease:** NOT free at the pin, which this note said until HO-TKB-PLAY-003 and the whole file said with it. manaCost is 0 and manaCostPercentage is 15, and Spell::CalculatePowerCost adds ManaCostPercentage * caster->GetCreateMana() / 100 to the cost, so the cleanse costs 15 per cent of base mana at every level. It removes a disease every 5 s for 20 s, so it outranks the single-shot cure from 32.
